payout_quote: Give your friends $20 to use on Rover. When they complete a service, you'll earn a $20 credit towards your next booking... Once your friend completes their first service, you'll be emailed a $20 promo code within 24-48 hours that you can upload to your account to use towards your next booking. (Official Rover Help Center, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: $20 promo code emailed 24-48 hours after the friend completes their first service
eligibility: Existing Rover account holder; friend must be a new Rover customer who signs up through your unique referral link (household members with existing accounts are ineligible)
steps: Log into Rover and copy your unique referral link (app: More menu; desktop: Give $20, Get $20 button)
Send the link to a friend with a pet who has never used Rover
They sign up through your link and complete their first pet-care service
You get a $20 promo code emailed within 24-48 hours
Apply it to your next Rover booking
catches: CREDIT, NOT CASH: the $20 is a promo code for Rover bookings only - it has zero value unless you book pet care on Rover
Your friend must complete a full paid service (not just sign up) before you earn anything
Friend must sign up through YOUR unique link; existing Rover accounts (including household members) are ineligible
UK amount is 15 pounds; US/Canada is $20 - amounts vary by country
biggest_catch: This is $20 of Rover booking credit, not money - worthless unless you actually pay for pet sitting or dog walking on Rover.

maximize: Only chase this if you already book pet care on Rover - then every referral is $20 off a bill you'd pay anyway. Target friends with pets who have never used Rover, since they must complete a real paid service for your credit to trigger. Make sure they sign up through your unique link - any other signup path earns you nothing.
